content.short: Bonadocs docgen simplifies smart contract integrations by generating beautiful, interactive documentation directly from code.
content.description: Bonadocs docgen automatically generates beautiful, interactive documentation for websites directly from the codebase. It supports collaborative documentation and seamless integration of smart contracts, improving how contracts are documented, organized, and interacted with within the docs. This enables both simple and complex workflows, providing developers with a code-driven, testable documentation surface to explore contract interfaces and facilitate interactions across supported networks.
